capabilities: Sync meetings from the Fathom API on demand via command or ribbon
Create one note per meeting with properties, summary, action-item tasks and a recording link
Store the Fathom API key in Obsidian's secret storage
Remember deleted notes so a later sync does not recreate them
Apply templates, tags, extra properties, daily note links and date or participant filters (Pro)
disambiguation: Not a vault or note-sync tool; it only imports Fathom meeting notes into your vault.
extras: Freemium: core sync is free; Pro features (transcripts, templates, filters, tags, extra properties) require a $5/month or one-time $15 GitHub Sponsors sponsorship. Unofficial and not affiliated with Fathom; the README documents privacy and network behavior in detail. After updates it opens a What's new tab that promotes other NoteMods plugins and Zovo Chat (can be disabled).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull meeting summaries and action items from a Fathom account into the vault as notes.

relations.evidence: The plugin only reads your own meetings through the public Fathom API, with an API key
It checks if the signed-in account sponsors theluckystrike

requires.name: GitHub Sponsors sponsorship of theluckystrike for Pro features

summary: Unofficial Fathom integration that syncs meeting summaries, action items and transcripts from the Fathom API into one vault note per meeting.
